ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Ulysses S. Grant Synthetic CCD

text.paragraph: Primary care visit for four weeks of right-sided throat pain and painful swallowing in a heavy cigar smoker. Concerns: Right-sided throat pain for four weeks, worse with swallowing, that has not improved; Wants a clear answer about the diagnosis quickly so he can plan for his family and finish his memoir; Has smoked cigars most of his life and is unsure he can stop. [S]

tr.td: Varenicline 0.5 mg oral tablet, one tablet daily for three days, then one tablet twice daily
One tablet by mouth daily for three days, then twice daily
Varenicline 1 mg oral tablet, one tablet twice daily

Acetaminophen 160 mg/5 mL oral solution, 20 mL (640 mg) every 6 hours as needed for throat pain
20 mL by mouth every 6 hours as needed for pain; no more than 3,000 mg a day
Lidocaine viscous 2% solution, 15 mL swish and spit up to every 3 hours as needed for throat pain
Swish 15 mL and spit up to every 3 hours as needed, no more than 8 doses a day; do not eat or drink for 60 minutes after use

tr.td: Primary care visit for four weeks of right-sided throat pain and painful swallowing in a heavy cigar smoker
Otolaryngology consultation with flexible laryngoscopy and biopsy of the right tonsillar lesion
Primary care visit after staging to coordinate nutrition, dental care, tobacco cessation, and symptom control before treatment
Primary care visit three weeks after completing chemoradiation directed by the head and neck oncology team
Urgent otolaryngology–head and neck surgery referral for a persistent right tonsillar lesion with painful swallowing in a heavy cigar smoker, for laryngoscopy and biopsy within two weeks
Order a contrast-enhanced CT of the neck before the specialist visit, and PET/CT for staging once biopsy confirms carcinoma
Tobacco cessation: advise stopping cigars, set a quit date, behavioral counseling at every visit, and varenicline

Nutrition: dietitian assessment before treatment, a soft calorie-dense diet with oral supplements, and a weight at every visit; the head and neck team decides on a feeding tube if weight loss nears 10%
Dental evaluation and fluoride care before radiation to the neck
Symptom control with liquid acetaminophen and topical lidocaine, pain scored at each visit, and escalation by the oncology team during treatment
Check CBC, basic metabolic panel, and albumin before and after treatment; baseline TSH before neck radiation, repeated every six to twelve months afterward
Screen for depression with the PHQ-2 at each primary care visit after the diagnosis
Tissue diagnosis within two weeks of the first visit
Biopsy at the otolaryngology visit two weeks after presentation
Stop all tobacco use before treatment begins
No cigars since mid-July 2026; varenicline continued
Limit weight loss to less than 10% of baseline weight through treatment
Weight 71.0 kg, 9% below the 78.0 kg baseline
Keep throat pain at 4 or below on the 0-10 scale most days
